name: project-baseline
description: Testable readiness standard. One script over repo files: every rule is deterministic, reads the tree only, and is AND-gated to a single exit code — any failing rule fails the build. There is no warn tier and no opt-in pack. Two opt-ins remain, with opposite defaults: the TRUST CIRCLE (the plugins a repo has adopted — opt in, default out) and the BASELINE RULES LAYER (every other rule — opt out, default in, config key baseline_rules). Rules with no subject resolve n/a and are excluded from the gate.
